title: Audit cadence: enforce flag and three gap kinds
goal: The audits table shows audit.enforce and the gap review proposes the three cadence actions
acceptance: "Audits, reviews and harness" Last audit cell gains enforce on or enforce off
Kinds: never fully audited (no full manifest without a blocked area), full audit overdue (older than audit.days), full audit with enforce off
Fixture tests in tools/test-profiles.mjs, committed failing first: one fixture per kind; a current full audit with enforce on produces none
A component with no audit settings uses the defaults (days 7, enforce off) and the gap reads as a proposal, not a failure
privacy: Fixtures are invented repositories and manifests; no personal data.
escalation: A change to how existing gap kinds behave goes back to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: three gap kinds over data projectHealth already reads, one table cell and fixtures. Not a measurement.
